title: Croque-Madame
subtitle: Ham and Gruyère toasted sandwich with béchamel and fried egg
excerpt: The croque-monsieur made famous: a thick ham-and-Gruyère sandwich with béchamel on top, grilled until bubbling and golden, then crowned with a fried egg. A bistro classic that is better than it has any right to be.

recipe.sourceNotes: The croque-monsieur appeared on Paris café menus around 1910 and has been a bistro staple ever since. The croque-madame is the same sandwich topped with a fried or poached egg, the egg said to resemble a lady's hat. The essential element that distinguishes a proper croque from a toasted cheese sandwich is the béchamel: the sauce goes on top of the bread and is grilled until it puffs and turns golden. Without it you have a good toasted sandwich; with it you have a croque.

content.text: Use proper pain de mie or a dense white bread that will not collapse under the béchamel. Cheap sliced bread goes soggy. The Gruyère inside should be grated, not sliced: it melts more evenly. The béchamel should be thick enough to hold its shape on top of the sandwich without running. If it runs off the sides before it goes under the grill, it is too thin: cook it longer before spreading.

items.preparation: or pain de mie, cut 1.5 cm thick

content.text: Make the béchamel: melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat. Add the flour and stir for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Cook, stirring, for 4 to 5 minutes until thick. Season with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg. Set aside.

Heat the grill to high. Butter the bread slices on both sides. Toast lightly on both sides under the grill. Spread the inner surfaces with Dijon mustard. Layer ham and two-thirds of the Gruyère inside to build 2 sandwiches. Place on a baking tray.
Spread the béchamel over the top of each sandwich. Scatter the remaining Gruyère over the béchamel. Grill for 3 to 4 minutes until golden and bubbling.
While the sandwiches are grilling, fry the eggs in butter until the whites are just set and the yolks still soft. Place one egg on top of each sandwich and serve immediately.
